description: Establish a green baseline on the feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign branch before changing anything. Install deps if needed and confirm typecheck, lint, and the vitest suite all pass so later changes are measured against a known-good state.
steps: cd /projects/sandbox/wecare-digital and confirm the current branch is feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign with `git branch --show-current`. Do NOT switch or create branches.

If node_modules is absent, run `npm install`. Sandbox node is v22.23.3 while .nvmrc pins 24; if a hard node-version gate blocks install/scripts, record it in findings but proceed if typecheck/lint/test still run.
Run `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run lint` (eslint .) and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run test` (vitest run) and confirm all tests in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx and the rest of the suite pass. Note the green test count in findings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test exits 0 with the VayuLokLive suite green
findings: Green baseline confirmed on branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign (git branch --show-current matches). node_modules already present (no npm install needed). Sandbox node v22.23.3 while .nvmrc pins 24 / engines node>=24, but no hard node-version gate blocked any script - all three commands ran and passed. Results: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint` (eslint .) exit 0 with 0 errors / 203 warnings (pre-existing, mostly react-hooks/set-state-in-effect + one unused eslint-disable in CartCheckout.test.tsx); `npm run test` (vitest run) exit 0 => 73 test files passed + 1 skipped (74 total), 902 tests passed + 3 skipped (905 total). VayuLokLive suite green on its own: 13 tests passed. No source edits made (git status shows only the untracked task-state dir). Note: PillButtonBuildScope.test.ts (3) and SignInHeaderClearance.test.ts build-gated cases are skipped by design until a full next build runs - expected, not a failure. Live Google map/overlay does not render in sandbox (browser key referrer-restricted) - expected, verification is typecheck+lint+vitest only.
